messages:
Maya: Quick ping — planning a regional canary for model v13 later today 18:00Z. Target regions: EU & APAC (exclude CN). Ramp: 1% -> 5% over 2h. Need a fast sanity check on allowlist/guardrails and fallback. If no objections in 30m I’ll schedule the toggle.

Raj: +1. One strong ask: keep SLA customers off the canary. Prefer an allowlist for the orgs we want to exclude from random exposure. I’ll post the org IDs.

Raj: ```json
{"rule":"allowlist_org_ids","ids":["org_123","org_789","org_555"]}
```

Maya: OK switching to allowlist. Good catch. Will not include support-tier orgs.

Maya: @sre-bot can you confirm capacity headroom in eu-west-1 if we start at 1% and go to 5%? Also want a safety auto-fallback if latency or errors spike.

sre-bot: current_pool: eu-west-1 gpu_util=0.58 queued_requests=8 headroom_est=7% — baseline indicates safe for 1%->5% ramp but monitor p95.

Lucas: Request: add auto-fallback to model-13-q4 (quantized) when p95 latency > 300ms OR error_rate > 0.8% for 5m. We shouldn't do manual only.

Maya: Agree. Proposed gate: p95 > 300ms OR 5m error_rate > 0.8% -> immediate rollback to fallback variant + reduce audience to 0. Also plan to pause ramp if any region has sustained increase.

Olivia: Analytics ok with rollout_id tagging. I’ll add telemetry tags: rollout_id=v13-regional-2026-03-18, cohort, region, percent. Will provision a dashboard with these metrics and a simple health panel.

Maya: Putting final flag config here for review: ```yaml
rollout_id: v13-regional-2026-03-18
audience:
  regions: [eu, apac]
  percent_schedule: [{t0:0m, p:1}, {t120m, p:5}]
  allowlist_org_ids: [org_123, org_789, org_555]
fallback: model-13-q4
gates:
  - name: p95_latency
    threshold_ms: 300
    window: 5m
  - name: error_rate
    threshold_pct: 0.8
    window: 5m
notifications: [#incidents, @oncall]
```

Raj: small nit — use `exclude_for_sla: false`? Actually leave as allowlist. Also set `rollout_owner: maya` and `contact: oncall` in metadata.

Maya: Added those fields. Scheduling toggle for 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z. If no objections by 17:30Z we flip. :thumbsup: 

Lucas: :thumbsup: from infra side. I’ll monitor latency and be ready to flip fallback.

Olivia: Dashboard ✅. I’ll post link once created.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle: rollout_id=v13-regional-2026-03-18 at 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z (requested by Maya)

Maya: Final note: rollback playbook — immediate rollback to v12 if gate triggers then page oncall and post to #incidents. Pin checklist in thread.
